title: Pharmacy Profile Setup & GST Rule 46 Bill Prefix

intro.title: Pharmacy Profile & GST Rule 46 Prefix
intro.subtitle: Configure statutory licenses, store branding, and compliant invoice numbering

narration.text: Welcome to Part 5. Every invoice issued to a patient is a statutory tax document. Let's configure your pharmacy identity, legal licenses, and bill numbering in Store Settings.
narration.caption: Configure your pharmacy identity, statutory licenses, and invoice numbering.

narration.text: Under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, your Drug License 20B and 21B numbers must appear on every cash memo. Enter your 15-character GSTIN to ensure hassle-free tax credits.
narration.caption: Enter Form 20B/21B Drug Licenses and 15-digit GSTIN for statutory compliance.

narration.text: Next is the Bill Serial Prefix. Under GST Rule 46, invoice serials must be consecutive and within 16 characters. Set a prefix like INV or MED, and MediFlow auto-generates the financial year serial.
narration.caption: GST Rule 46: Set prefixes like INV or MED for auto-formatted consecutive serials.

narration.text: Configure your receipt format: choose fast Thermal 80mm rolls for high-traffic retail counters, or detailed A4 Tax Invoices with comprehensive CGST and SGST breakdowns.
narration.caption: Select Thermal 80mm rolls for fast checkout or A4 for full GST ledger breakdown.

narration.text: Click Save Changes. Your settings update across all POS counters immediately. This concludes Phase 1! Watch Part 6 to begin Phase 2: Basic Counter Billing with fast search and Auto-FEFO.
narration.caption: Settings saved! Phase 1 complete. Watch Part 6 for POS Counter Billing & Auto-FEFO.

outro.takeaway: Statutory Rule 46: Tax invoices must follow consecutive serial numbering unique for each financial year.
